scope.intent: Retailer-visibility candidate pool for later live catalog reconciliation and GTIN ownership checks.

methodology: Used current observable German retailer pages and search-result renderings from dm, Rossmann, Mueller, and selected specialist/brand pages as prioritization signals.
Treated category listing order, availability, review count, sponsored placement, retailer PDP existence, and repeated retailer presence as visibility evidence only, never market-share proof.
Kept candidate_lane unresolved until a later live database reconciliation can decide existing GTIN backfill versus genuinely new product intake.
Captured GTIN only where it was explicit in a retailer PDP snippet/page or in a retailer URL whose path is the visible product identifier; no GTINs were inferred from names.
